### Eating Breakfast with Jesus
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/eating-breakfast-with-jesus
Passage: John 21:11-12
Points:
- Even after His resurrection and exaltation, Jesus willingly served His disciples by preparing bread and fish for their breakfast.
- Christ's humble attention to His followers' physical exhaustion and hunger provides a lasting model for how believers should care for each other.
- The detail of catching exactly 153 fish serves as authentic eyewitness evidence of Jesus' historical post-resurrection ministry.
- The disciples' respectful silence reflected the holy awe and reverence due to the risen, incarnate Lord.
- Familiarity with the Gospel accounts should never dull our reverence or diminish our worship of Christ.

### Day 223: John 21:1–7a
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-223-john-21-17a.html
Passage: John 21:3
Points:
- Facing an identity challenge and uncertainty after the resurrection, the disciples defaulted to their old routine of fishing.
- When believers are unsure how they fit into God's immediate plan, they are called to be still and trust rather than strive in their own strength.
- Jesus met the disciples in the middle of their fruitless labor, interrupting their striving with His personal presence.
- Like John, Christians need discernment to recognize the Lord's presence and direction amid everyday circumstances.
